title: P1 msg.ack and msg.nack: request
description: A read mark or a return of an entry by its handle. msg.ack only marks the entry for acknowledgement: the acknowledgement happens in the complete transaction of the attempt. msg.nack at once returns the entry to the inbox with the dispatch count one greater; after the third dispatch the entry becomes dead(delivery_exhausted) (MSG-9).

items.description: Handle of the inbox entry that the core gave to this attempt: an opaque string, used to reply (reply_to) and to return the entry. The ids of the entry, the worker and the tenant are not visible in it.

handles.description: Handles of the entries given to this attempt.
